title: THE FIRE ESPER
subtitle: Terra and the jester
logline: Losing to the jester, Terra stops fighting and starts praying - and something answers.
grade: 2D anime film, hand-drawn cel animation, painted backgrounds, a forest clearing at dusk, shafts of low sunlight, drifting mist.
avoid: lowres, blurry, morphing, warping, melting, flicker, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, two of the same person, subtitles, captions, watermark, nsfw

place.prompt: A forest clearing ringed by huge trees and standing stones, painted as an anime background.

esper.prompt: The fire esper: its character sheet (studio/sheets/the-fire-esper), made from one Flux 2 picture.

shots.name: losing
shots.title: losing
shots.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation. Wide side view of the clearing at dusk, she on the left, he on the right: (1) the lanky harlequin jester in a purple-and-yellow diamond costume and two-horned cap juggles three glowing purple orbs, laughing; (2) the young woman with long wavy sea-green hair, a red dress and red boots, bruised and breathing hard, takes a step back; (3) wind stirs the leaves between them. The clearing, the trees, the standing stones and the light stay as they are. Sound: wind, his giggle, the hum of the orbs. No music.
